newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tse Sui Luen places 47 mln warrants.
newsitem.headline: Tse Sui Luen places 47 mln warrants.

text.p: Tse Sui Luen Jewellery (International) Ltd said it would privately place 47 million 1997-1999 warrants to third parties at an issue price of HK$0.54 per warrant to subscribe for up to HK$148.05 million in shares.
Each warrant will entitle holders the right to subscribe for one company share at HK$3.15 each, subject to adjustment, between the date of issue and October 31, 1999, it said.
Upon full exercise of the warrants, 47 million new shares or 15.93 percent of the company's enlarged share capital would be issued, the company said.
Dealing in the warrants on the Hong Kong stock exchange will commence on May 2, it said.
Net proceeds from the warrant issue of about HK$22.4 million would be used for general working capital, it said.
Tse Sui Luen shares rose HK$0.20 to HK$3.35 in late morning.
